summary: Iteration 13 batch verified end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass covering (a) POST /api/admin/leads/{id}/fund happy path + 400 (amount<=0) + 404 + wallet increases + transaction with source=lead_fund and created_by=admin email; (b) POST /api/admin/wallet/adjust reason-required + add + deduct-over-balance 400 + valid deduct + wallet_adjustments row visible in /detail; (c) PUT /api/admin/customers/{id}/profile logs history with by=admin email + duplicate mobile 400 + address restore; (d) PUT /api/admin/customers/{id}/kyc invalid PAN 400, valid update keeps status=verified and logs kyc_history by admin email; (e) GET /api/admin/customers/{id}/detail returns wallet+profile_history+kyc_history+wallet_adjustments+transactions; (f) admin /api/admin/leads?date_from&date_to filters (future dates -> 0 rows); (g) /api/go/<slug> redirects <3s, invalid slug -> /offer-ended; (h) PUT /api/profile by customer stores history with by='self'. Frontend (admin logged in via injected rt_token): AdminLeads per-row copy icons (copy-leadid/name/mobile/email) render, clicking copy-mobile writes to clipboard (toast 'Mobile copied 9222222222'), pasting into lead-search filters to exactly 1 row (the target lead). Custom Range chip opens lead-custom-range panel with lead-custom-from/to inputs; setting future dates yields lead-empty; lead-custom-clear resets and removes lead-date-range-label; today preset still applies label. Lead detail modal exposes 5 per-field copy icons (lead-detail-copy-*) + lead-detail-copy-id + lead-fund-section + lead-add-fund enabled for a lead with partner. Fund modal default amount pre-fills from campaign payout (₹500), lead-fund-next -> lead-fund-confirm-box renders. AdminCustomers row shows credit-btn/adjust-btn/edit-btn; WalletAdjustDialog exposes all 3 modes + amount/reason/next/balance testids. CustomerEditDialog tabs profile/kyc/history all render with expected inputs and save buttons. AdminKyc kyc-edit-<id> opens CustomerEditDialog on KYC tab (pan visible). Lazy admin routes /admin, /admin/campaigns, /admin/withdrawals load without blank screens. Customer /profile shows kyc-status='Verified' and kyc-save button label reads 'Update KYC'; /my-leads renders 9 leads with 54 per-field copy icons (my-lead-copy-*).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1015 admin_fund_lead — no idempotency key. Repeated rapid clicks on 'Yes, add ₹X' will credit multiple times (UI disables the button while busy but a network retry / dup POST from another tab is unbounded). Consider requiring a client-generated ref_id or hashing (lead_id, amount, admin, minute) to dedup.

server.py:1731 admin_adjust_wallet — the balance check uses `before['balance'] + 0.001` tolerance which is fine, but 'zero' mode inserts a debit transaction sourced 'admin_adjust' without ref_id prefix 'WD'. The dashboard aggregate (server.py:1813) explicitly excludes debits where ref_id does not start with 'WD' when computing total_wallet — the wallet_adjust debit is thus DOUBLE-COUNTED against `total_earnings - total_paid - total_pending_amt - <non-WD debits>`, dropping the reported total_wallet_balance further than it should. Recommend either (a) filtering source=admin_adjust out of the debit sum in dashboard, or (b) adding a prefix to the adjust ref_id and updating the dashboard filter.

server.py:685 _apply_kyc — allows re-submitting KYC when status was 'rejected' by admin and silently promotes it back to 'verified' when called through admin_edit_kyc (line 1792 passes keep_status='verified' for any of not_submitted/pending/rejected/verified). This bypasses the admin-rejection audit. If the intent is that admin edit auto-approves, at least log the promotion in kyc_history (currently only field diffs are captured).

AdminLeads.jsx:73 — the Custom Range panel renders when `customOpen || flt.preset==='custom'`, but clicking any other preset does NOT close customOpen if the user set it via lead-preset-custom (it stays true and panel remains open with the preset dates prefilled). Consider closing customOpen when a non-custom preset is chosen for a cleaner UX.

CopyValue.jsx:9 — the execCommand('copy') fallback path requires an element in DOM. In some browsers (Safari private mode) navigator.clipboard.writeText is missing AND execCommand is deprecated; consider surfacing a fallback toast when both paths fail. Currently a silent 'Copied' shows even on failure.

server.py:802 go_affiliate — background.add_task inserts click AFTER response is sent but uses request.headers/request.client which are still accessible; good. However `partner` lookup uses `account_status: {$nin:[disabled,deleted]}` — a 'deactivated' partner (paused via UI) still logs their user_id on click and can accrue lead credit later. Confirm this is intended vs. treating deactivated as also invalid ref.
